enter_failed: Couldn't start local mode. Please try again.
replace_desc: Signing in to an existing account replaces the tasks currently on this device. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.
account_required_desc: Sharing needs an account. Create one - your tasks are kept and start syncing.
account_invite_desc: Keep your tasks, sync them across devices, and enable sharing. Your current tasks are kept.
backup_reminder: Tip: export a backup regularly - local data can't be recovered if you lose this device.

welcome.title: Working offline - no account
welcome.subtitle: Your tasks live only on this device.
welcome.point_storage: Your data stays on this device and never reaches our servers.
welcome.point_no_sync: No sync between devices and no cloud backup.
welcome.point_no_recovery: No recovery if you lose this device or clear app data - export a backup regularly.
welcome.point_upgrade: You can create an account at any time - your tasks are kept and start syncing.

passcode.settings_item_desc: Local (no-account) mode: lock this device with a passcode that encrypts your local key
passcode.settings_intro: This option is only for local (no-account) mode. A local passcode encrypts your data key on this device. You'll enter it each time you open the app after closing it. There is no recovery - if you forget it, the local data is lost.
passcode.setup_desc: Encrypt your local key with a passcode. Without one, the key is stored unencrypted on this device.
passcode.change_desc: Enter your current passcode and choose a new one.
passcode.min_length: Passcode must be at least {min} characters.
passcode.save_failed: Could not save the passcode. Please try again.
passcode.lock_now_desc: Lock the app and require the passcode again.
passcode.remove_desc: Stop encrypting the local key with a passcode.
passcode.remove_confirm_desc: Remove the passcode? Your local key will be stored unencrypted on this device again.
passcode.locked_desc: Your data is locked on this device. Enter your passcode to unlock it.
passcode.reset_desc: There is no way to recover a forgotten passcode. You can reset the app, but this permanently erases all local data on this device.
